title: Researchers revive a key TB drug with antibiotic pairing

needs.need: How the combination performed against either drug alone in the same mouse experiment.
needs.accepts: A credited statement that neither isoniazid alone nor vancomycin alone significantly reduced bacterial burden in the mice after 10 days, unlike the combination.

example.value: Neither drug used alone significantly reduced bacterial burden in the mouse model after 10 days of treatment.
example.source: Indian Institute of Science researchers, as reported by The Hindu

needs.need: How many people a year develop drug-resistant TB, as distinct from all TB.
needs.accepts: A credited annual global estimate of people developing a named form of drug-resistant TB (for example multidrug- or rifampicin-resistant TB), with its year. An all-TB total does not meet it.

example.value: An estimated 400,000 people developed multidrug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant TB worldwide in 2023.

needs.need: What treatment is already used for drug-resistant TB, so the experimental pairing is placed beside it.
needs.accepts: A credited description of at least one currently recommended regimen for a named drug-resistant TB category, with its length, kept distinct from the experimental pairing.

example.value: WHO recommends a six-month, all-oral BPaLM regimen (bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid and moxifloxacin) for eligible patients with multidrug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant TB.
example.source: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 4: Treatment, 2022 update

needs.need: What multidrug-resistant TB is and which resistance types the study tested.
needs.accepts: A credited explanation that multidrug-resistant TB resists at least isoniazid and rifampicin, with the study's tested isolates named as isoniazid-resistant and multidrug-resistant, not every form of drug-resistant TB.

example.value: Multidrug-resistant TB is resistant to at least isoniazid and rifampicin. The IISc study included isoniazid-resistant and multidrug-resistant clinical isolates.
example.source: WHO for the definition; The Hindu for the study's scope

needs.need: The team's stated next development step, without implying a human trial is scheduled.
needs.accepts: A credited statement that the team is working to take the combination toward clinical trials, kept distinct from a confirmed trial start.

example.value: The team is working to advance the combination for clinical trials.
example.source: Indian Institute of Science researchers, as reported by The Hindu

notNeeded.why: The study's publication is the trigger; no policy change or outbreak needs explaining.
A history of TB drug development is not needed once the comparator, resistance scope and existing treatment are clear.

notes: The draft's response need (the pairing itself) was cut: it is the story's news, not a response beside it; existing-resistant-tb-treatment is the response need instead, and the story does not state it. MDR/RR-TB burden sizes the wider problem, not the patients this pairing could treat.
